name: progress
title: Progress Bar
description: Shows how far a task has got, or that it is working when the duration is unknown.

examples.name: progress-demo
examples.title: Progress bar
examples.description: A labelled bar with its value.

examples.name: progress-indeterminate
examples.title: Indeterminate
examples.description: A sliding segment when the duration is unknown; a quiet static bar with reduced motion.

examples.name: progress-tones
examples.title: Tones, ranges and sizes
examples.description: Success, warning and danger fills, a custom range with a value label, and the small size.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without one, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby (the types require one of the three).

props.name: value
props.description: Current value, between minValue and maxValue.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: Unknown duration: no value is announced and a segment slides along the track.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the formatted value at the inline end of the label row.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Replaces the formatted value, e.g. '4.1 of 5 GB'.

props.name: tone
props.description: Fill colour. default uses the brand accent.

notes: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/min/max and aria-valuetext from React Aria; indeterminate bars omit aria-valuenow.
The label is wired with aria-labelledby.
Tone changes the fill colour only; say what it means in the label or nearby text.
The indeterminate slide runs only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and follows the reading direction.

do: Use determinate progress whenever you can compute it.
Use warning/danger for limits (storage, spend), not for task progress.
dont: Don't use a progress bar for a value that isn't progress toward something — use a meter or text.
Don't show an indeterminate bar for less than a second; show nothing, or a Spinner.
